mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods with declining RSAFS, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and simultaneously nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline by more than 100,000 in the past month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% annualized, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and GDPC1 growth < 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized, it signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above 3% annualized over the past 6 months signals robust supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in a late-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 3% does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05) in late-cycle expansions.
